| Day 30 - Makeover #rstats
Revisiting day 1 and points. This time with legends, explanatory text, roads and trains lines, plus popup for each count site with breakdown of figures.


Show the code
# arrange from largest to smallest so smallest drawn last
# and so appear on top
dft <- dft |> arrange(desc(all_motor_vehicles))
# provide html for popup
dft <- dft |> mutate(
  popup = 
    paste0(
      "<div style='font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: #084081; line-height: 1.2;'>",
      "Site: ", count_point_id,"</div>",
      "<div style='font-size: 12px; color: #666; font-weight: 500;'>",
      "<table>",
      "<tbody>",
      "<tr>",
      "<td>Road name</td>",
      "<td>", road_name, "</td>",
      "</tr>",
      "<tr>",
      "<td>Estimation method</td>",

      "</tr>",
      "<tr>",

      "</tr>",

)

border <- read_sf(geodata, layer = "TSS boundary")
roads <- read_sf(geodata, layer = "TSS Checklist") |> filter(CLASS == "A")

# nominatim_polygon <- nominatimlite::geo_lite_sf( address = "west sussex, uk", points_only = FALSE)
# bbox <- sf::st_bbox(nominatim_polygon)
# train_routes <- opq(bbox) |> 
#   add_osm_feature(key = "route", value = "train") |> 
#   osmdata_sf() |> 
#   use_series(osm_lines)
train_routes <- train_routes |> st_transform(crs = 27700) |> st_intersection(border)
train_routes <- train_routes |> filter(name != "Littlehampton Miniature Railway")

maplibre(style = carto_style("positron")) |> 
  fly_to(center = c(-0.4045492, 50.9365654), zoom = 10) |> 
  add_fill_layer(id = "border",
                 source = border,
                 fill_color = "navy",
                 fill_opacity = 0.1) |> 
  add_line_layer(id = "roads",
                 source = roads,
                 line_color = "navy",
                 line_opacity = 0.3) |> 
  add_line_layer(
    id = "train_routes",
    source = train_routes,
    line_color = "white",
    line_width = 2,
    line_cap = "round"
  ) |> 
  add_circle_layer(source = dft,
                   id = "dft counts",
                   circle_color = interpolate(column = "all_motor_vehicles", 
                                              values = c(0, 10000, 95000), 
                                              stops = c(dft_color[[1]], 
                                                        dft_color[[2]], 
                                                        dft_color[[3]])),
                   circle_radius = interpolate(column = "all_motor_vehicles", 
                                               type = "linear", 
                                               values = c(0, 1000, 5000, 15000, 
                                                          30000, 50000, 70000, 
                                                          1e+05), 
                                               stops = c(1, 2, 4, 7, 9, 10, 12, 
                                                         14)),
                   circle_stroke_color = "white",
                   circle_opacity = 0.8,
                   circle_stroke_width = 1,
                   # popup = concat("Total: ", get_column("all_motor_vehicles"))
                   popup = "popup"
  ) |> 
  add_continuous_legend(
    legend_title = "DfT count sites<br />all motor vehicles",
    values = c(0, 10000, 95000),
    colors = c(dft_color[[1]], 
               dft_color[[2]],
               dft_color[[3]]),
    position = "bottom-left",
    style = list(
      background_color = "grey",
      background_opacity = 0.4)
  ) |> 
  add_categorical_legend(
    legend_title = "Transport modes",
    values = c("road", "train"),
    colors = c("#0000804D", "white"),
    position = "top-right",
    style = list(
      background_color = "grey",
      background_opacity = 0.4),
    # must have:
    add = TRUE
  ) |> 
  add_control(
    html = paste0(
      "<div style='font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \"Segoe UI\", Roboto, sans-serif; ",
      "background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95); padding: 16px 20px; border-radius: 8px; ",
      "box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); max-width: 430px;'>",
      "<div style='font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: #084081; line-height: 1.2;'>",
      "DfT traffic count sites in West Sussex</div>",
      "<div style='font-size: 12px; color: #666; font-weight: 500;'>",
      "Map of West Sussex in England, showing recorded vehicle traffic at specific<br />",
      "points with train routes.",
      "<br />𝚖𝚊𝚌𝚔𝚊 𝚜𝚣𝚎𝚌𝚑𝚗𝚘<br />30 November 2025",
      "</div>"
    ),
    position = "top-left"
  ) |> 
  add_fullscreen_control(position = "top-left")

title: Introduction
text:
Introduction
30DayMapChallenge is a opportunity for geospatial data experts to showcase their skills with an entire month, November, dedicated to a different challenge per day.



Categories for 2025


This is my contribution in which I demonstrate proficiency in GIS - Earthlight amd QGIS - and R, the statistical programming language, and the following geospatial visualisation packages: leaflet, mapview, mapsf, tmap, and mapgl.
The code sections below are hidden by default but can be viewed to better understand the creation of maps in a reproducible environment.
Feel free to pan and zoom on the maps provided. Some have additonal outputs that will be revealed by hovering or clicking on elements.
Others are merely images as the data involved would be too much (or in the case of GIS products, there’s no way to create an interactive environment).

Setup
Some housekeeping to get all shared datasets in one place. Feel free to skip this bit.


Show the code
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(units)

library(leaflet)
library(leaflet.extras)
library(leaflet.extras2)
library(leafem)
library(mapview)
library(mapgl)
library(tmap)
library(mapsf)

d <- read_sf("../Kolochep/shapefile/districts/districts/OS.WESTSUSSEX_DISTRICT.shp") |> filter(NAME %in% c("Crawley District", "Horsham District", "Mid Sussex District"))
d <- d |> select(NAME)




| Day 28 - Dark #rstats
Firefly map of West Sussex in England, showing areas of light pollution


Show the code
lights <- read_sf("../30days2025/data/SEC_STRLIGHT.shp")
lights <- lights |> st_intersection(d)
boundary <- d |> summarise()

maplibre(style = carto_style("dark-matter-no-labels")) |> 
  fit_bounds(d) |> 
  add_circle_layer(id = "Streetlighting2",
                   source = lights,
                   circle_color = "#6bb857",
                   circle_opacity = 0.8,
                   circle_radius = 2,
                   ) |> 
  add_circle_layer(id = "Streetlighting1",
                   source = lights,
                   circle_color = "#ffffff",
                   circle_opacity = 0.8,
                   circle_radius = 1,
                   ) |> 
  add_line_layer(id = "boundary",
                source = boundary,
                line_color = "yellow",
                line_width = 2) |> 
  add_control(
    html = paste0(
      "<div style='font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \"Segoe UI\", Roboto, sans-serif; ",
      "background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95); padding: 16px 20px; border-radius: 8px; ",
      "box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); max-width: 430px;'>",
      "<div style='font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: #084081; line-height: 1.2;'>",
      "Streetlighting in West Sussex</div>",
      "<div style='font-size: 12px; color: #666; font-weight: 500;'>",
      "Firefly map of West Sussex in England, showing areas of light pollution",
      "<br />Restricted to Crawley, Horsham, and Mid Sussex districts for size.",
      "<br />𝚖𝚊𝚌𝚔𝚊 𝚜𝚣𝚎𝚌𝚑𝚗𝚘<br />28 November 2025",
      "</div>"
    ),
    position = "top-left"
  ) |> 
  add_fullscreen_control(position = "top-left")
